description: Convert a pre-July-2025 Vietnamese address (63 provinces, districts, wards) into the new 2-level structure (34 provinces, wards). Returns the new ward/province, mapping type (unchanged/merged/divided) and all candidates when the old ward was split. When the client supports elicitation, the server may ask the user to pick the new ward for a split old ward (chosenBy: user|default).
name: vn_address_convert
title: Convert old address to new (2025)
